entities.name: Oton Iveković
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Oton Iveković was a Croatian painter. A graduate of Academy of Fine Arts in Vienna, Iveković later taught at the Academy of Fine Arts in Zagreb. He largely concerned himself with historical topics as well as some religious themes. Many of his paintings remain the chief representations of Croatian history.
